tools.name: copilot.check_environment
tools.title: Check Copilot CLI Environment
tools.description: Verify that the local Copilot CLI is installed and report available local custom agents.

cwd.description: Optional working directory used to discover the nearest project-level .github/agents folder.

tools.name: copilot.list_agents
tools.title: List Copilot Agents
tools.description: List available local Copilot CLI custom agents from project and user agent directories.

cwd.description: Optional working directory used to discover the nearest project-level .github/agents folder.

tools.name: copilot.run_agent
tools.title: Run Copilot Agent
tools.description: Run the local Copilot CLI with an explicit custom agent or with prompt-based agent selection.

message.description: Prompt text to send to Copilot.

agent.description: Optional custom agent id (file stem without .agent.md). When omitted, Copilot chooses normally.

cwd.description: Optional working directory passed to Copilot with -C. Defaults to the workspace root.

attachments.description: Optional files attached to the initial prompt.

continueSession.description: Resume the most recent Copilot session before sending the prompt.

resumeSession.description: Resume by session id, id prefix, task id, or exact session name. Mutually exclusive with sessionId and continueSession. The interactive session picker is intentionally not exposed by this hosted tool.

sessionName.description: Optional name for a newly created session. Cannot be combined with a resume option.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional native Copilot reasoning effort level.

invocationMode.description: How to target the agent: flag (default, uses --agent) or prompt (injects an explicit instruction into the prompt).

runMode.description: sync (default) waits for completion; async starts a background run and returns a run id for later polling/cancellation.

tools.name: copilot.list_runs
tools.title: List Copilot Runs
tools.description: List Copilot runs started through this MCP server process.

tools.name: copilot.get_run
tools.title: Get Copilot Run
tools.description: Get the current state and output of a previously started Copilot run.

runId.description: The run id returned by copilot.run_agent in async mode.

tools.name: copilot.cancel_run
tools.title: Cancel Copilot Run
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running Copilot CLI process started by this MCP server.

runId.description: The run id returned by copilot.run_agent in async mode.
